_status: PRE-INTEROPERABILITY LOCAL READINESS VECTOR. Not yet submitted to or accepted by Vauban. No StillOS digest has been anchored in a real Vauban v3 batch. This vector demonstrates local encoding correctness against Vauban's published spec; it is not a claim of interop.

vauban_spec_reference.source: x402-foundation/x402#3389 (comment by @seritalien, 2026-09-08T15:53:58Z) and vauban-org/x402-starknet docs/stark-receipt-profile-v0.1.md §4.1-4.2, re-fetched and cross-checked live during this pass -- byte-identical formula in both sources, no drift.
vauban_spec_reference.v3_root_preimage: Poseidon(['VZKPAY_AGGROOT_V3', K, currency_id, subject_type, (subject, nullifier, amount) x K, F, (origin_tag, digest_lo, digest_hi) x F])
vauban_spec_reference.limb_encoding_rule: For 256-bit digest D (big-endian integer): digest_lo = D mod 2^128, digest_hi = D >> 128. Mirrors Cairo's u256 {low, high}. Lossless -- both limbs together losslessly reconstruct D.

source_receipt.provenance: Real live StillOS Notary production receipt (agent=stillos-foreseal-preflight-check), not a synthetic fixture.
source_receipt.digest_algorithm: SHA-256 (see ../docs/STILLOS_NOTARY_RECEIPT_V1.md for the full preimage/canonicalization spec)

independent_derivation.cross_checked_division_vs_bitwise_shift: both derivations of digest_hi (D / 2^128 and D >> 128) agree, computed independently in the same run

what_this_vector_does_and_does_not_prove.proves: The StillOS receipt_hash correctly and losslessly maps to Vauban's published v3 foreign-leaf digest_lo/digest_hi encoding, computed independently with no dependency on Vauban's own code.
what_this_vector_does_and_does_not_prove.does_not_prove: That Vauban has agreed to the STILLOS_NOTARY_RECEIPT_V1 tag, that this specific digest has been included in any real v3 batch, that a StillOS receipt has ever been anchored on Starknet, or that Vauban's own implementation produces the identical limb split (this vector was not cross-verified against Vauban's own encoder -- only against their published formula).
